conditions: The selected try or catch block supplies a result and the finally block, if present, completes normally.
limitations: Abrupt completion, exception propagation and platform-specific exception mechanics remain separately scoped.

triggers: Recheck any publisher correction, source integrity change, or contrary evidence about the pinned RFC edition.

statement: The Kotlin/Core 1.9 RFC describes the value of a normally completing try expression as the last expression of the try body if it throws no exception, or the last expression of the matching catch block if an exception is caught. The finally block does not supply that value.
